description: Vertical 1080x1920 dark background. Center-frame rounded phone frame (white border, dark fill) occupying middle 35-75% height, glowing Lucide CircleHelp question mark in accent cyan centered inside. Bold kinetic captions in fg white middle-band pop with scale punch: 'Got a question?' then '60 SECOND CARTOON' in accent2 magenta and accent3 yellow. Play triangle icon morphs in over question mark. Camera zoom pulse 105% on beat. No elements in top 10% or bottom 25%.

beats.action: Phone frame snaps in center with glowing cyan question mark; word Got pops large white center-middle.
Word question? pops accent cyan beside Got; question mark icon pulses glow and shakes.
Question mark morphs to white play button in magenta circle; words sixty second slam in accent2 below.
Word cartoon pops accent3 yellow large; cartoon sun doodle bursts behind play button; camera zoom pulses in.
Word back. pops white; phone frame bounces and glows, holding hero pose.

description: Split comparison shot. Left panel (x 8-46%, y 18-72%): dim grey article card with dense muted text lines, title 'Black Holes Explained' + author row, scrolling upward continuously. Right panel (x 54-92%, y 18-72%): clean vertical player card with cyan border, play icon, progress bar accent cyan at bottom of card, timer counter '0:60'. Center VS badge. Background dark. Accent red X stamps for too long/vague. Good green check for clear answer.

beats.action: Split layout slides in; left article card fades in with question bubble 'black holes or blockchains?' above it.
Article title highlights to 'BLACK HOLES'; second chip 'blockchains' pops accent2 on left card.
Left article scrolls fast upward endlessly; clock icon spins; word FOREVER stamps red.
Two red badges slam on left: 'TOO LONG' and 'TOO VAGUE'; left card dims to muted grey.
Right player brightens with green check; words CLEAR ANSWER pop white inside player; progress bar starts filling.
Right progress bar races 0-100% in cyan with speed lines and '60s' counter ticking fast; left stays stalled.

description: Three-phase vertical layout in dark scene. Top-center (y 15-25%): white chat query box typing 'why is the sky blue?'. Middle (y 28-48%): 2x2 grid of script blocks labeled Hook accent cyan, Setup accent2, Mechanism accent3, Payoff good green. Lower canvas (y 50-70%): side-view sky demo with yellow sun left, cyan rays, atmosphere band; small blue dots and red dots as particles. Center-middle big caption words white with yellow highlight. Bottom-middle (y 72%): mini vertical phone badge with share icons.

beats.action: Query box types 'why is the sky blue?' character by character with cursor blink top-center.
Query box shrinks up; pen icon writes; four empty script blocks fly in to 2x2 grid.
Four blocks label in: Hook, Setup, Mechanism, Payoff with numbers 1-4; '4 BEATS' counter pops.
Blocks light cascade cyan to green ending on Payoff; all four pulse done state with checkmarks.
Calm narrator waveform bar + Lucide AudioLines icon appears above blocks; blocks dim, voice line sweeps.
Lower canvas wipes in: yellow sun left with cyan sunbeams scattering rays animating outward.
Dozens of blue dots spawn and bounce zigzag everywhere inside atmosphere band, trails cyan.
Red dots fly straight through left-to-right with motion streaks, passing through while blue keeps bouncing.
Big captions 'BLUE BOUNCES / RED PASSES' pop word-by-word center with yellow highlight box.
Mini vertical phone badge + '60s VERTICAL' pill and share icons pop bottom-middle; progress bar loops.

description: Center phone frame (same size/position as hook, x centered y 30-75%) playing finished cartoon: inside mini sun + blue bouncing dots + red straight dots looping, big word-by-word captions white/yellow center of phone. Cyan looping progress bar at bottom of phone, timer '0:60' and Lucide Share2 + Heart icons right side. Background dark with soft cyan glow. Final beat phone content crossfades to large glowing cyan question mark, rhyming hook frame 0 for seamless loop.

beats.action: Phone snaps center with reel playing; red prohibition badge 'NO FILMING' with Lucide CameraOff slams and vanishes.
Second badge 'NO EDITING' with Lucide Scissors slams over timeline that cuts away; timeline disappears.
Words PURE UNDERSTANDING pop good green inside phone; glow brightens.
Progress bar loops 0-100% twice with repeat arrow icon; dots animation loops seamlessly.
Kinetic caption 'Got a question?' pops above phone; question bubble icon appears.
Caption '60 SECOND CARTOON BACK' pops; phone content morphs to glowing cyan question mark matching hook, holding for loop.
